title: Executable work and release gates still missing
summary: Separate Queue Fabric XTP channel and multicast integration is an unqualified backlog, not a merged implementation.
invariants: Implement optional channel adapter over actual SocketSelector/provider APIs preserving queue.transport/2 authentication.
Verify two-process XTP queue transfer, wrong-key/unknown-service/revocation, retransmission, restart and idempotent durable receipt.
Verify multicast 2+ managers, partial quorum, retained-state UOW, membership epoch and per-manager unicast repair.
Verify Planner tickets under domain contraction/emergency, WLU pre-CLAIM, priority and refusal/fallback.
Verify actual permitted ED209 L2/raw36/UDP paths with controlled rollback; XTP local loopback is insufficient.
Qualify this sphere with Gopher validate/lint/context/search; static tests alone do not establish this.
